text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Fitted black leather zip jacket over red short puff sleeve ruched-front top and white lace camisole, dark indigo low-rise bootcut jeans, black and white low top canvas sneakers.. Add ONLY these accessories: A delicate silver chain necklace with a tiny pale blue silver butterfly pendant, full chain loop.; A matched pair of medium thin silver hoop earrings.; A women’s medium brown leather shoulder satchel with adjustable long leather strap and aged metal buckles.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Fitted black leather zip jacket over red short puff sleeve ruched-front top and white lace camisole, dark indigo low-rise bootcut jeans, black and white low top canvas sneakers.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: A delicate silver chain necklace with a tiny pale blue silver butterfly pendant, full chain loop.; A matched pair of medium thin silver hoop earrings.; A women’s medium brown leather shoulder satchel with adjustable long leather strap and aged metal buckles.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
